answer: A burden draft prices sybils out. Each epoch, a block-randomness lottery conscripts 5% of identities for eight-hour duty at 12 tokens hourly. Refusal or failure means a 40-token slash plus three zero-weight epochs. Validators audit duty logs at close and auto-slash missing checkpoints. Cloning n identities multiplies draft exposure n-fold, so cost grows linearly with n; the wage cannot cover the slash risk. At the zenith the draft hits idle clones; at the nadir, absent ones too, as seeding ignores uptime. Like yarrow, sybils spread fast, yet each stem serves when drawn.
